findings.title: Date overrides bypass busy-time checks
findings.body: When a slot falls within a date override, this returns `true` immediately, before checking `busy`. Date overrides add availability; they must not make an already-booked slot or a slot conflicting with a connected calendar event bookable. Fixed-host and round-robin availability can therefore include slots that the host is busy for.

findings.title: Working-hours check ignores the slot end time
findings.body: `end` is calculated from the slot start rather than from `slotEndTime`. Consequently, a slot that starts before a working-hours boundary but whose event duration extends past it passes this check. When slots generated from another host's availability are evaluated for a fixed host, this can allow bookings that extend beyond that host's working hours.
